task_summary: Extract population data from PDF and income data from Excel, merge them, compute quartiles and derived columns, then produce a multi-sheet Excel report with four pivot tables and a source data sheet.
decomposition_rationale: The task has three distinct concerns: (1) data ingestion from heterogeneous sources (PDF + Excel), (2) data transformation including merging, quartile computation, and pivot table generation, and (3) multi-sheet Excel export with proper formatting. Separating ingestion from transformation/export keeps each skill focused and reusable.

skills.name: evo-demographic-data-ingestion
skills.description: Extracts and cleans tabular data from PDF files using pdfplumber and from Excel files using pandas/openpyxl. Handles multi-page PDF table stitching, header deduplication, numeric parsing (comma removal, type casting), and string normalization for merge keys.
skills.responsibility: All data extraction and cleaning from source files (PDF and Excel). Produces clean, merge-ready DataFrames with normalized column names, stripped/uppercased string keys, and properly typed numeric columns.
dr_sections: Section 1: pdfplumber PDF Table Extraction API (Version 0.11.4)
Section 2: Excel Data Ingestion using pandas and openpyxl
Section 3: Advanced Data Merging and Entity Resolution

skills.name: evo-demographic-analysis-reporting
skills.description: Merges population and income DataFrames, computes quartile assignments via pd.qcut with rank-based tie handling, generates derived columns (Total = EARNERS × MEDIAN_INCOME), creates all four pivot tables (Population by State, Earners by State, Regions by State, State Income Quartile), and exports everything to a multi-sheet Excel workbook with proper formatting.
skills.responsibility: All data merging, transformation (quartile assignment, derived columns), pivot table generation, and multi-sheet Excel output. Handles sheet ordering, index management for pivots, and column width auto-fitting.
dr_sections: Section 3: Advanced Data Merging and Entity Resolution
Section 4: Analytical Summarization with pandas Pivot Tables
Section 5: Quartile Assignment and Discretization via pandas qcut
Section 6: Exporting Multi-Sheet Excel Workbooks and Formatting
Section 7: Version-Specific Caveats: pandas 2.2.3 and openpyxl 3.1.5
Section 8: Architectural Patterns for Robust Data Pipelines
